name: Püspökladány (Hungary)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with the town arms of Püspökladány (a blue shield with a white crane, with a helm, a crane crest and red and blue mantling) above the name PÜSPÖKLADÁNY in black.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Püspökladány arms with helm, crest and mantling
